title: 第068章 全基地庆祝第067章 何天紫调解师徒
slug: 全民修仙之系统上交囯家
content_zh:
庆祝从第二天中午就开始了。先是食堂那边搬出来的长条桌，从广场东侧一直摆到西侧，拼接处的缝隙被桌布压住，桌布是深红色的，边角还带着上次庆典留下的褶皱。后勤处的人从仓库里翻出灯笼和彩带，彩带被灵能烘干机重新吹过之后恢复了蓬松，红的、金的、蓝的，在午后的日光下反着柔和的光，被风吹动时发出极细的沙沙声。炊事班加了三倍的菜量，灵兽肉开了最贵的那批冷库，油锅从辰时就开始响，一直没停过，像一面正在被反复敲打的鼓。空气里混着炸物和灵草香料加热后特有的那种焦甜气息，还有刚切开的新鲜瓜果的凉甜味，混杂在一起，像一层看不见的薄纱正在缓缓覆盖整个广场。
广场上的人正在陆续聚集。穿常服的多，但也有人穿着制式战甲就来了，肩甲上还带着没来得及擦净的灰尘，像是刚从外面赶回来的巡逻队。孩子们在长桌之间的空隙中穿行，跑得快的把鞋带跑散了，也没有停下来系。张山风在广场上跑了一圈，手里端着一只叠了三层的大托盘，盘里是刚出锅的炸灵果，油还泛着细密的气泡。他穿过人群走到东侧，把托盘放在长桌一端，然后被几个同期弟子拉住了胳膊，半拖半拽地按在了一条长凳上。
"别急着走啊，坐下吃点。"其中一个说，嘴角还沾着一点油光，"你这东跑西跑的，跟后勤处的人抢活干啊？"
张山风被按着坐下了，凳子腿压住了一角桌布，他弯腰去扯，被旁边的人按住了肩膀。"你看那边——"那人抬了抬下巴。
张山风顺着他的目光看过去。广场西侧的灵草田边上，四神兽正围坐成一个不规整的圆，中间的空地上已经堆了一小堆东西。朱雀用喙从一棵灵草根部衔出一枚暗红色的果实，那果实比它的喙大两倍，它歪着头调整了一下角度，然后轻轻一甩头，果实滚进了那堆东西的边缘，碰上了一旁玄武壳边放着的一串淡紫色的灵果。青龙盘在最外侧，尾巴尖从堆好的那堆果实之间轻轻拨过，把一枚快要滚出边缘的黄色灵果勾回了原位，动作轻得像怕碰碎了它。白虎在另一侧蹲着，尾巴垂在地上，视线在那堆东西上停留了一会儿，然后它站起来，转身朝广场外围的灌木丛方向走去。
张山风看着它走远的方向，手里的筷子停了一下，但没有跟上去。
四神兽堆在中间的东西慢慢成形了，从一堆杂乱的果实变成了一个有轮廓的堆叠。朱雀垫在最底层，把一枚枚浅金色的灵果排成圈；青龙用尾巴把第二层的紫色灵果码在金色上面；玄武在第三层放了几枚淡蓝色带纹路的果实，然后退后半步，壳抵着地面，看了看，又往前挪了一步，调整了其中一枚的位置。然后它退回去，没有再动。
新居的窗开着。
何天紫坐在窗边的躺椅上，透过灵晶窗看着广场方向的光。那扇窗正好面朝广场东侧，能把四神兽围坐的那片灵草田边缘收入视野。她看见那堆正在被一层层垒高的果实，颜色从底部的浅金到中层的淡紫再到上层的深蓝，像一座微型的塔。她看了一会儿，没有出声。
张德华从她身后走过来，手里端着一杯温热的灵茶，放在她手边的台面上。他顺着她的目光看向窗外，看到那堆正在被四神兽调整位置的果实塔，然后看到白虎正穿过广场外围的灌木丛往回走，步伐平稳，嘴里叼着一只活的灵鹿。那只鹿的体型不大，后颈皮被白虎的牙齿咬住，四蹄悬空，眼睛睁着，嘴里发出极轻的嗯嗯声，像在表示某种温和的抗议。白虎叼着它穿过广场边缘的人群边缘，人群自动让开了一条通道，没有人伸手拦它，但所有人的目光都跟着它移动，像看一队正在经过的仪仗。白虎走到那堆果实塔旁边停下来，没有松口，低头把灵鹿放在果实塔前面大约一步远的位置，然后退后半步蹲下，尾巴盘在爪子上。鹿站在果实塔前面，四蹄着地后抖了一下，低下头闻了闻最底层那圈金色灵果的边缘，然后抬起头，看向白虎，又看向果实塔，再看向白虎。白虎没有动。它的尾巴尖微微翘了一下，像一面正在被缓缓升起的旗。
何天紫从窗边侧过头来，隔着一层灵晶窗和半片广场的距离，看了一眼张德华。她没有说话，但张德华看见了她的目光。他放下手里的茶盏，走下楼，穿过走廊和通道，走到广场西侧灵草田的边缘。他在距离白虎大约五步远的地方停下来。白虎的耳朵转了一下，没有侧头。
张德华低头看了一眼那只鹿，鹿站在果实塔前面，四蹄微微岔开，像是在确认脚下的地面是否稳固。他开口了："放回去。谁让你抓活的？"
白虎没有松口。它的耳朵折了一下，像是正在解读这句话的权重，然后它用前爪轻轻拨了一下鹿的侧面，力道不大。鹿被拨得原地转了小半圈，转向了广场外围的灌木丛方向。白虎又拨了一下，力道比第一次大一些，鹿开始朝灌木丛方向走了两步，停下，回头看了一眼白虎。白虎甩了一下尾巴，像在说"走吧走吧"，鹿终于迈开了步子，小跑着钻进了灌木丛，枝叶摇晃了几下，安静了。白虎的尾巴在身后拖出一道极浅的扫痕，它转身走回果实塔旁边蹲下，耳朵竖着，姿态跟之前一模一样，仿佛刚才什么都没有发生过，只是一场需要它亲自处理的小意外。
广场东侧有人笑了。笑声从一个人开始，然后扩散成了十几个人，然后变成了几十个人的，像一面正在被风推动的湖面，波纹正在一圈一圈地向外扩展。何天紫坐在窗边，手里那杯灵茶还冒着极淡的白汽。她没有看向窗外。但她嘴角的弧度和平时不太一样。
张德华站在原地，看了一眼那堆已经被垒成三层的果实塔，又看了一眼蹲在塔旁边的四神兽。朱雀正把一枚滚到边缘的紫色灵果勾回原位。青龙的尾巴尖又拨了一下塔身中间那层的某枚果实，像在给一尊正在缓慢风干的泥塑进行最后的修整，然后慢慢收回了尾巴。灵果塔在日光下泛着一层柔和的混合光泽，从底部的浅金到中层的淡紫再到上层的深蓝，像一幅被压缩的秋天的画布。
傍晚的光线正在变暗，灯笼一盏一盏被点燃了。红色的光从东侧开始向西侧蔓延，一盏接一盏地亮起来，像一条正在被依次点燃的引线。彩带被风吹起又落下，在暖色的光线中像一些正在缓慢游动的生物。盘子空了又满了。炊事班的人换了一轮，后厨正在继续炸新的。那盏新居窗边的灯也亮了，光从灵晶窗透出来，暖黄色的，像一块被放在窗台上的琥珀。有人抬头看了一眼那扇亮起来的窗，又低下头去跟旁边的人碰了一下杯。声响脆而短促，在暮色中格外清楚。
四神兽堆的那座果实塔仍然立在原处。张山风从长凳上站起来，朝着四神兽那个方向走了几步，停下，蹲下来看了看那座塔。塔身大约两尺高，底层的金色灵果被码得规整，中层的紫色果实表面泛着一层极淡的光泽，顶层的深蓝色果实微微凸起，像一枚正在缓慢上升的穹顶。他看了一会儿，站起来。他没有碰它。他走回到长桌旁边，拿起筷子夹了一块已经凉下来的炸灵果放进嘴里，嚼了嚼咽下去，然后又夹了一块。
暮色正在持续地变厚。广场上的声音还在持续，从傍晚一直持续到了夜里，直到灯笼的光把整片广场照成了一片暖红。灵果塔没有被碰倒，它在四神兽中间安静地立着，像一个正在被完成的承诺。
新居的门比原来那间宽了一尺。门框是张德华自己改的，他把走廊那面墙往外扩了半尺，换了扇双开门的门板，方便抬东西进出。门板表面涂了一层哑光漆，漆面还没干透，边缘处泛着一层极淡的潮气。何天紫坐在堂屋里的躺椅上，椅背调成了半倾斜的角度，垫了一层薄棉褥子，是她自己搭上去的。窗外的光从灵晶窗透进来，被滤成了一种柔和的暖白色，落在地板上像一面正在缓慢融化的乳白色油脂。
四神兽的守护从第二天开始。当天深夜，新居外的走廊里响起了第一声极轻的脚步声。

玄武最早到。它从走廊西侧走过来的时候没有发出任何声音，龟壳的边缘擦过墙壁，连一丝刮痕都没有留下。它在门外停下，用壳的侧面轻轻碰了一下门板——三下，力道很轻，像一个人在用指节叩门之前先用指腹试了试温度，然后缩回壳里，在门内测蹲了下来。何天紫在躺椅上侧过头来，隔着门板的方向看了一眼。她听见那种极轻的、像一块石头被放在地毯上的声响，然后就没有动静了。她知道那是谁。
第二天早上，张德华从卧室出来的时候，在门口停了一步。玄武已经把自己安置好了，它的壳抵着门框内侧，头缩在壳里，只露出两只眼睛，朝着走廊的方向。它看见张德华，眼睛眨了一下。
"主人放心，"玄武的声音从壳里传出来，慢而低，像一块正在被缓慢打磨的石头，"我会保护好夫人的。"
张德华站在门内，低头看了它两息，没有说"不用"。"好。你守白天还是晚上？"
"都行。"玄武说，它的头从壳里伸出来了一些，转动了一下，"夫人需要的时候，我都在。"
张德华继续走向走廊深处。背后的玄武已经重新把头缩回了壳里，只剩两只眼睛朝着走廊方向，像两盏正在值守的夜灯。何天紫从躺椅上侧过头来看向门口的方向，她看见那扇门和门外的那道坚硬的轮廓，忽然开口说了一句，声音里带着刚刚醒来时才会有的微微哑意："玄武守门口的话，那朱雀怎么办？"
朱雀是在午后到的。它没有从走廊走，从窗户进来的。灵晶窗被它用喙轻轻推开了一道缝，然后它收拢翅膀，像一片落叶一样从窗缝里滑进来，落在了壁炉上方的架子上。架子是铁木打的，原本放着几本书和一只花瓶。朱雀落上去的时候用爪子把花瓶往旁边拨了半寸，让出了足够的空间，然后蹲下来，羽毛微微蓬松，像一团正在被风缓慢吹散的火焰。壁炉没有生火，但朱雀蹲上去之后，架子周围的空气温度升高了大约两度。一股干燥的、带着火焰余烬气息的暖意从它的方向扩散开来，缓缓漫过整间堂屋的中央。
何天紫把手从腹部上方抬起来，伸向壁炉的方向，指尖停在空中。那种温度从她的指尖渗进来，像一只正在被缓慢暖热的手套，从指腹开始，沿着指节向上蔓延，经过掌心，一直延伸到小臂中段。她放下手，微侧的脖颈微微偏了一下，没有收回目光。
"我可以给夫人暖床。"朱雀开口了。它的声音比玄武清亮，像一枚被敲响之后还在持续振动的薄铁片，尾音微微上挑，从壁炉架子上方传下来，穿过堂屋的暖空气层落在何天紫的躺椅边缘。
何天紫的嘴角动了一下，那个弧度不大，但她没有压住它。她侧过头来看向朱雀的方向："暖床也行。这几天晚上确实有点凉。"
朱雀的羽毛从蓬松变成了贴紧，那声"嗯"从喉咙深处挤出来，尾音微微上翘，像一枚已经接住了的硬币在指间停稳时发出的轻响——它在架上换了一个蹲姿，爪下的铁木架子承受了新的重心后发出一声轻微的吱嘎声，又稳住了。何天紫低下头，继续看手里的书页，窗外的灵草田上正有三只灰色的鸟在缓慢飞过，它们的翅膀扇动得很慢，像是被午后的热度压住了速度。
傍晚的时候，张德华从指挥中心回来，推开门时首先看到的是玄武的壳，然后是青龙盘在窗下矮榻上的尾尖，最后是朱雀蹲在壁炉架子上的轮廓。他解外袍的手在半空中停了一下。"——都来了？"
"嗯。"何天紫说，她仍然靠着躺椅，手指在书页边缘停着，没有翻页，"朱雀说要给我暖床。"
张德华把外袍挂在门边的架子上，走过来，站在堂屋中央。他的目光从玄武的壳移到壁炉架子上，在朱雀的羽毛边缘停了一下，又移开了。然后他开口了，声音不高，像一个人在陈述一件已经决定好的事："不用暖床，守着门口就行。"
朱雀歪了一下脑袋，像是在消化这六个字的含义。它没有反驳，但它在架上换了一个蹲姿，爪尖在铁木表面划过一道极轻的声响，又重新站稳了。何天紫的笑声是从堂屋南侧靠窗的位置传过来的，不大，像一个正在被风吹远的铃铛，但传遍了整个房间。那笑声让朱雀的羽毛重新蓬松了一度。青龙在窗下的矮榻上从盘着换成了伸展开的姿态，尾尖拍了一下榻面。玄武的壳在地毯边缘往墙脚贴近了半寸。白虎的耳朵竖了一下。它没有动，但它的尾巴尖翘了一下，像一面正在被缓慢升起的旗，旗杆顶端正在缓慢上升。
何天紫没有把笑压回去。她的指尖搭在腹部的上方，轻轻停了一瞬。"暖床也不错，"她说，"那等晚上再说。"
content_en:
The celebration started at noon the next day. First, there was the long table that was moved out from the canteen, and it was placed from the east side to the west side of the square. The gaps at the joints were suppressed by the tablecloth. The tablecloth was dark red, and the corners still had wrinkles from the last celebration. People from the logistics office dug out lanterns and ribbons from the warehouse. The ribbons were fluffy again after being blown through the psychic dryer. They were red, gold, and blue, reflecting soft light in the afternoon sun, and making a very fine rustling sound when blown by the wind. The cooking team tripled the amount of food, and opened the cold storage for the most expensive batch of spirit animal meat. The oil pan started making noises at midnight and never stopped, like a drum being beaten repeatedly. The air was mixed with the unique burnt-sweet smell of fried food and spiritual herbs and spices, as well as the cool and sweet smell of freshly cut fruits. They were mixed together, like an invisible veil that was slowly covering the entire square.
People in the square are gathering one after another. There were many people wearing regular clothes, but there were also people who came wearing standard battle armor, and the shoulder armor still had dust that hadn't been wiped off in time, like a patrol that had just come back from outside. The children were running through the gaps between the long tables, running so fast that their shoelaces fell apart without stopping to tie them. Zhang Shanfeng ran around the square, holding a large tray stacked three layers in his hand. On the tray was freshly fried spiritual fruit, and the oil was still filled with fine bubbles. He walked through the crowd to the east side and placed the tray at one end of the long table. Then he was grabbed by the arm by several fellow disciples and half dragged and half pushed to a bench.
"Don't leave in a hurry. Sit down and have something to eat." One of them said, with a little grease on the corner of his mouth. "You are running around here and there, competing for work with the people in the logistics department?"
Zhang Shanfeng was forced to sit down. The leg of the stool pressed against a corner of the tablecloth. He bent down to pull it, but the person next to him held down his shoulders. "Look over there -" the man raised his chin.
Zhang Shanfeng followed his gaze and looked over. On the edge of the spiritual grass field on the west side of the square, the four divine beasts were sitting in an irregular circle, and a small pile of things had been piled in the open space in the middle. Suzaku used its beak to pick out a dark red fruit from the root of a spiritual grass. The fruit was twice as big as its beak. It tilted its head to adjust the angle, and then flicked its head. The fruit rolled into the edge of the pile and hit a bunch of lavender spiritual fruits placed beside the Xuanwu shell. The green dragon was coiled on the outermost side, and the tip of its tail gently passed between the piles of fruits, and hooked a yellow spirit fruit that was about to roll out of the edge back to its original position. The movement was so light as to avoid breaking it. The white tiger squatted on the other side, with its tail hanging on the ground. Its eyes stayed on the pile of things for a while, then it stood up, turned around and walked towards the bushes outside the square.
Zhang Shanfeng looked at the direction in which it was walking away. The chopsticks in his hand paused for a moment, but he did not follow it.
The pile of four divine beasts in the middle slowly took shape, turning from a messy pile of fruits into a contoured stack. Suzaku placed on the bottom layer and arranged the light golden spirit fruits in a circle; Qinglong used his tail to place the purple spirit fruits on the second layer on top of the golden ones; Then it retreated without moving again.
The windows of the new house are open.
He Tianzi sat on the lounge chair by the window, looking at the light in the direction of the square through the spiritual crystal window. That window just faced the east side of the square, and could bring into view the edge of the spiritual grass field where the four divine beasts were sitting around. She saw the pile of fruits being built up layer by layer, with colors ranging from light gold at the bottom to lavender in the middle to dark blue at the top, like a miniature tower. She watched for a while and said nothing.
Zhang Dehua came up from behind her, holding a cup of warm spiritual tea in his hand and placed it on the table beside her. He followed her gaze and looked out the window, seeing the pile of fruit towers being adjusted by the four divine beasts, and then saw the white tiger walking across the square.He walked back through the bushes outside the field, walking steadily, holding a live spirit deer in his mouth. The deer was not big, and the back of its neck was bitten by the white tiger's teeth. Its hooves were hanging in the air, its eyes were open, and it made a very light hum sound from its mouth, as if it was expressing some kind of gentle protest. The white tiger held it in its mouth and passed through the edge of the crowd at the edge of the square. The crowd automatically gave way to a passage. No one stretched out their hands to stop it, but everyone's eyes followed it, like watching a group of honor guards passing by. Bai Hu walked to the pile of fruit towers and stopped without letting go. He lowered his head and placed the spirit deer about one step away in front of the fruit towers. Then he took a half step back and squatted down, with his tail wrapped around his paws. The deer stood in front of the fruit tower, shook after landing on all four hooves, lowered his head and smelled the edge of the golden spiritual fruit at the bottom, then raised his head and looked at the white tiger, then at the fruit tower, and then at the white tiger. The white tiger didn't move. The tip of its tail was slightly raised, like a flag being slowly raised.
He Tianzi turned his head from the window and glanced at Zhang Dehua across the distance between a layer of spiritual crystal window and half of the square. She said nothing, but Zhang Dehua saw her eyes. He put down the tea cup in his hand, walked downstairs, walked through the corridors and passages, and walked to the edge of the spiritual grass field on the west side of the square. He stopped about five steps away from the white tiger. Bai Hu turned his ears without turning his head.
Zhang Dehua lowered his head and glanced at the deer. The deer stood in front of the fruit tower, its hooves spread slightly, as if to confirm whether the ground under its feet was stable. He spoke: "Put it back. Who asked you to catch him alive?"
The white tiger did not let go. Its ears folded, as if it was interpreting the weight of this sentence, and then it lightly touched the side of the deer with its front paws, not very hard. The deer was turned around in a small half circle and turned towards the bushes outside the square. The white tiger dialed again, with more force than the first time. The deer started to take two steps toward the bushes, stopped, and looked back at the white tiger. The white tiger flicked its tail, as if to say "Let's go, let's go." The deer finally took a step forward and trotted into the bushes. The branches and leaves swayed a few times and became quiet. The white tiger's tail dragged a very shallow trace behind it. It turned around and walked back to the fruit tower and squatted down, with its ears erect and its posture exactly the same as before, as if nothing had happened just now, it was just a small accident that needed to be dealt with personally.
Someone laughed on the east side of the square. The laughter started from one person, then spread to a dozen people, and then became dozens of people. Like a lake being pushed by the wind, the ripples were expanding outward in circles. He Tianzi was sitting by the window, the cup of spiritual tea in his hand still emitting very light white steam. She didn't look out the window. But the curvature of the corners of her mouth was different from usual.
Zhang Dehua stood there and glanced at the pile of fruit towers that had been built into three floors, and then at the four divine beasts squatting next to the tower. Suzaku was hooking a purple spirit fruit that had rolled to the edge back to its original position. The tip of Qinglong's tail flicked a certain fruit in the middle layer of the tower, as if giving final touches to a slow-drying clay sculpture, and then slowly retracted its tail. The Lingguo Tower glows with a soft mixed luster under the sunlight, from the light gold at the bottom to the lavender in the middle to the dark blue at the top, like a compressed autumn canvas.
The evening light was fading and the lanterns were lit one by one. The red light spread from the east side to the west side, lighting up one after another, like a fuse being lit one after another. The colorful ribbons were blown up and down by the wind, looking like some slowly swimming creatures in the warm light. The plate is empty and full again. The people in the cooking class have changed a round, and the back cook is continuing to fry new ones. The light by the window of the new house also turned on, and the light came out from the spiritual crystal window, warm yellow, like a piece of amber placed on the windowsill. Someone looked up and glanced at the lighted window, then lowered his head and clinked a glass with the person next to him. VoiceThe sound was crisp and short, especially clear in the dusk.
The fruit tower among the four divine beasts still stands in its original place. Zhang Shanfeng stood up from the bench, walked a few steps in the direction of the four divine beasts, stopped, squatted down and looked at the tower. The tower is about two feet high. The golden spiritual fruits on the bottom layer are arranged neatly. The purple fruits on the middle layer have a very light luster on their surface. The dark blue fruits on the top layer are slightly raised, like a slowly rising dome. He looked for a moment and then stood up. He didn't touch it. He walked back to the long table, picked up his chopsticks, picked up a piece of fried spiritual fruit that had cooled down, put it into his mouth, chewed it, swallowed it, and then picked up another piece.
The twilight continues to thicken. The sound in the square continued, from evening to night, until the light of the lanterns illuminated the entire square in a warm red. The Spirit Fruit Tower was not knocked down. It stood quietly among the four divine beasts, like a promise being fulfilled.
The door of the new house is one foot wider than the old one. The door frame was modified by Zhang Dehua himself. He expanded the corridor wall half a foot and replaced the door panel with a double door to make it easier to carry things in and out. The surface of the door panel is coated with a layer of matte paint. The paint has not yet dried, and there is a very faint layer of moisture around the edges. He Tianzi was sitting on the recliner in the main room. The back of the chair was adjusted to a semi-inclined angle, and there was a thin cotton mattress on it, which she put on herself. The light outside the window filtered through the spiritual crystal window and turned into a soft warm white, falling on the floor like a milky white grease that was slowly melting.
The protection of the four divine beasts begins on the second day. Late that night, the first very light footsteps sounded in the corridor outside the new home.
Xuanwu arrived first. It made no sound as it walked from the west side of the corridor, and the edge of the turtle shell scraped against the wall without leaving even a scratch. It stopped outside the door, lightly touched the door panel with the side of its shell - three times, the force was very light, like a person testing the temperature with his fingertips before knocking on the door with his knuckles, then retracted into the shell and squatted down inside the door. He Tianzi turned his head on the recliner and glanced in the direction of the door panel. She heard a very light sound, like a stone being placed on the carpet, and then there was no movement. She knew who it was.
The next morning, when Zhang Dehua came out of the bedroom, he stopped at the door. Xuanwu had already positioned himself, with his shell pressed against the inside of the door frame, his head retracted inside the shell, and only his two eyes exposed, facing the direction of the corridor. It saw Zhang Dehua and blinked.
"Master, don't worry," Xuanwu's voice came from the shell, slow and low, like a stone being slowly polished, "I will protect my wife."
Zhang Dehua stood inside the door, looked down at it, and did not say "no". "Okay. Do you want to watch during the day or at night?"
"Anything is fine." Xuanwu said. Its head protruded a little from the shell and turned a little. "Whenever Madam needs it, I will be there."
Zhang Dehua continued to walk deeper into the corridor. Behind him, Xuanwu had retracted his head into his shell, leaving only two eyes facing the corridor, like two night lights on duty. He Tianzi turned her head from the recliner and looked in the direction of the door. She saw the door and the hard outline outside the door, and suddenly said something, with the slight muteness in her voice that she had just woken up: "If Xuanwu guards the door, what about Suzaku?"
Suzaku arrived in the afternoon. It didn't come from the corridor, it came in through the window. It gently pushed open a crack in the spiritual crystal window with its beak. Then it folded its wings and slid in through the window crack like a fallen leaf, landing on the shelf above the fireplace. The shelf was made of ironwood and originally held several books and a vase. When Suzaku landed on it, he used his paws to move the vase half an inch to the side to make enough space. Then he squatted down, his feathers slightly fluffy, like a flame being slowly blown away by the wind. There is no fire in the fireplace;But after Suzaku squatted up, the air temperature around the shelf increased by about two degrees. A dry warmth with the smell of fire embers spread from its direction, slowly spreading through the center of the entire hall.
He Tianzi raised his hand from above his abdomen and stretched it towards the fireplace, with his fingertips suspended in the air. That kind of warmth seeped in from her fingertips, like a glove being slowly warmed, starting from the fingertips, spreading up along the knuckles, passing through the palms, and extending to the middle of the forearm. She put down her hand and tilted her neck slightly, without looking back.
"I can warm the bed for Madam." Suzaku said. Its sound is clearer than Xuanwu, like a thin piece of iron that continues to vibrate after being struck. The tail note rises slightly and comes down from the top of the fireplace shelf. It passes through the warm air in the main room and falls on the edge of He Tianzi's lounge chair.
The corners of He Tianzi's mouth moved. The arc was not big, but she did not suppress it. She turned her head and looked in the direction of Suzaku: "A bed warmer will do. It's really a bit cold at night these days."
Suzaku's feathers changed from fluffy to tight, and the "um" was squeezed out from deep in the throat, and the tail sound was slightly upward, like the soft sound made when a caught coin stopped between the fingers - it changed its squatting position on the rack, and the iron wooden frame under its paws made a slight creaking sound after bearing the new center of gravity, and stabilized again. He Tianzi lowered his head and continued to read the book in his hand. Three gray birds were flying slowly over the spiritual grass field outside the window. Their wings flapped very slowly, as if they were slowed down by the afternoon heat.
In the evening, Zhang Dehua came back from the command center. When he opened the door, the first thing he saw was the shell of Xuanwu, then the tail tip of the blue dragon coiled on the low couch under the window, and finally the silhouette of the Suzaku squatting on the mantel shelf. His hands untying his robe paused in mid-air. "—Are you all here?"
"Yeah." He Tianzi said. She was still leaning on the recliner, her fingers resting on the edge of the page without turning the page. "Suzaku said he wanted to warm my bed."
Zhang Dehua hung his robe on the shelf by the door, walked over and stood in the center of the hall. His eyes moved from the Xuanwu shell to the mantelpiece, pausing for a moment at the edge of Suzaku's feathers, and then moved away again. Then he spoke, his voice low, like someone stating something that had been decided: "There is no need to warm the bed, just guard the door."
Suzaku tilted his head, as if digesting the meaning of these six words. It didn't refute, but it changed its crouching position on the shelf, the tips of its claws scratched a very light sound on the iron wood surface, and stood firm again. He Tianzi's laughter came from the window on the south side of the main room. It was not loud, like a bell being blown away by the wind, but it spread throughout the whole room. That laughter made Suzaku's feathers fluff up again. Qinglong changed from coiled to stretched out on the low couch under the window, and patted the couch with the tip of his tail. Xuanwu's shell was half an inch closer to the wall from the edge of the carpet. Bai Hu's ears perked up. It didn't move, but the tip of its tail was raised, like a flag being slowly raised, and the top of the flagpole was slowly rising.
He Tianzi did not suppress his smile. Her fingertips rested on the top of her abdomen and paused for a moment. "It would be nice to warm the bed," she said, "Let's wait until night."
